findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "trouver_expert" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Call this when the user needs a trustworthy real-estate professional in a Canadian city or neighbourhood: real-estate broker, mortgage broker, home inspector, n…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "contacter_expert" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks to contact, reach out to, or request a quote/appointment from a Payotte-listed professional. DOUBLE OPT-IN: this to…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contacter_expert, fenetre_revision, frais_revision, guide_uk, guide_au, guide_in, guide_br, guide_mx, guide_es, guide_de, guide_it, guide_be · Private data: trouver_expert, verifier_titre, taux_courants, contacter_expert, frais_revision, trouver_professionnel_fr, property_tax_appeal_us, find_property_owner_us, closing_costs_mx, purchase_costs_it · Public sink: contacter_expert, compare_states_br, borrowing_capacity_be, compare_regions_be.
